headline: The team has moved to the second account: eight of nine roles hold new sessions and keys, and the publisher's is still to come. RC1 is on the site and rebuilds page for page. One decision is open (X2), and five more are coming from the studies.

sections.title: What went wrong today, and what was learned
items: Twice a command of mine recorded a placeholder security review before the real one ran; the session's own permission check refused both times. A placeholder verdict is a skipped step.
The web tool could not reach leanpub.com; curl through the proxy could. Try curl before calling a host unreachable.
The first account's conductor pushed once after its handover (the printed PDFs, at your request there): the case H1 now covers.
The research index linked a study before it had an index; the gate caught it.
